import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Get Mong Kok station coordinates
station_query = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, ST_AsText(coordinate::geometry) as coord_wkt
FROM air_quality_station
WHERE id = 14
""")
station_df = pd.read_sql(station_query, engine)
print("Station:", station_df)

# Find DECLARED_MONUMENT features, compute centroid, and distance to station
monument_query = text("""
SELECT 
    sa.name,
    ST_Distance(
        ST_Centroid(sa.geometry)::geography,
        (SELECT coordinate FROM air_quality_station WHERE id = 14)::geography
    ) AS dist_m
FROM sensitive_area sa
WHERE sa.category = 'DECLARED_MONUMENT'
ORDER BY dist_m
LIMIT 1
""")
result = pd.read_sql(monument_query, engine)
print(result)

nearest_monument = result['name'].iloc[0]
monument_dist_m = float(result['dist_m'].iloc[0])
print(f"Nearest monument: {nearest_monument}")
print(f"Distance: {monument_dist_m:.2f} m")
